title: In-Context Learning for MIMO Turbo Receivers
abstract: arXiv:2505.06175v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) turbo receivers iteratively exchange information between a soft-input soft-output detector and a decoder. Traditional implementations rely on pilot-based channel estimates, which can be poor in the case of short pilot sequences or mismatched channel models, resulting in significant performance degradation. To address this limitation, we introduce the EXTrinsic In-Context Learning Network (EXT-ICLNet), a Transformer-based detector that takes the pilots as in-context examples and is trained to approximate the symbol extrinsic posterior distribution given the pilots, without explicit channel estimation. EXT-ICLNet is thus compatible with existing turbo receivers, as it implements a log-domain prior skip connection, ensuring that the network learns only the extrinsic information. translated_title: 面向MIMO Turbo接收机的上下文学习
translated_abstract: 多输入多输出（MIMO）Turbo接收机在软输入软输出检测器和解码器之间迭代地交换信息。传统实现方式依赖于基于导频的信道估计，当导频序列较短或信道模型不匹配时，估计效果可能较差，从而导致显著的性能下降。为解决这一局限性，我们提出了外信息上下文学习网络（EXT-ICLNet），这是一种基于Transformer的检测器，它将导频作为上下文示例，并通过训练在给定导频的条件下近似符号的外验后验分布，而无需显式的信道估计。因此，EXT-ICLNet与现有的Turbo接收机兼容，因为它实现了对数域的先验跳跃连接，确保网络仅学习外信息。针对采用16-QAM调制和量化前端的4×4 MIMO系统的数值结果表明，EXT-ICLNet的性能优于……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出EXT-ICLNet，一种基于Transformer的MIMO检测器，它将导频作为上下文示例，无需显式信道估计即可直接近似符号外验后验分布，并与现有Turbo接收机兼容，有效解决了短导频序列或信道模型失配导致的性能下降问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes EXT-ICLNet, a Transformer-based MIMO detector that treats pilots as in-context examples and learns to approximate the symbol extrinsic posterior distribution without explicit channel estimation, remaining compatible with existing turbo receivers and effectively mitigating performance degradation caused by short pilot sequences or channel model mismatch.
